ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Insider Trading Rings
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent surge in insider trading investigations, including the George Santos case, and explore potential connections between cases.
questions: What are the common threads between insider trading cases?
How can regulators improve their detection and prevention methods?
ideas.insight: By examining the patterns and connections between insider trading cases, we may uncover a larger network of wrongdoing and identify areas for improvement in regulatory oversight.

ideas.title: Child Porn Investigations: A Growing Concern
ideas.description: This story would delve into the recent child porn investigations, including the Stark County volunteer assistant fire chief arrest, and explore the implications for law enforcement and public safety.
questions: What are the common characteristics of child porn investigations?
How can law enforcement improve their detection and prevention methods?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the trends and patterns in child porn investigations, we may identify areas for improvement in law enforcement strategies and public awareness campaigns.
